techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/content/level-design/LevelFlowEditor/index.tsx:115 No setPointerCapture anywhere in the context. Mouseleave ends the drag. There is no screen-space movement threshold: any mousemove after mousedown stages a move and mouseup commits it.

src/components/modules/content/level-design/LevelFlowEditor/ConnectionLines.tsx:90 Every link animates forever.
